run_trancos_handler: run the trancos_handler function to import and process the TRANCOS vehicle counting dataset from a tar.gz archive
create_gen_split: create a generator that yields PIL images and quantized vehicle count labels from a given image set list
extract_tarinfos: extract tarfile member entries filtered by a start string prefix and end string suffix from a gz archive
extract_image_list: extract a list of image filenames from a specified set file inside the TRANCOS tar archive
build_trancos_dataset: build a DownloadableDataset object with download URLs and the trancos_handler for the TRANCOS vehicle counting dataset
